# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform offering creative tools for users, comprehensive safety features for families, and advertising solutions through TikTok for Business.

TikTok provides a social entertainment ecosystem powered by ByteDance, featuring the For You feed algorithm, Community Guidelines enforcement, and business tools including Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, Creative Center, and TikTok Shop for brands and advertisers.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Community Guidelines
- Creator Marketplace
- In-Feed Ads
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Conversion optimization
- User-generated content
- Parental controls and youth safety
- Influencer marketing
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- App conversion optimization (ACO)
- Business Center
- Creative Exchange
- For You feed algorithm
- TikTok Shop

## Safety and User Guides

- [Guardian's Guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/guardians-guide): Parent guide to TikTok safety tools, controls, and Community Guidelines
- [New user guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/new-user-guide): Getting started guide for new TikTok users covering safety and setup

## Advertising Case Studies

- [Netflix | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/netflix-195): Netflix case study: Christmas miniseries campaign using TikTok ads
- [Lingokids | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/lingokids-363): Lingokids case study: ACO campaign for app conversion optimization
- [Cetaphil | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/cetaphil-357): Cetaphil skincare: brand affinity campaign in Canada with creators
- [Justmop | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/justmop-370): Justmop: app installs via TikTok Creator Marketplace in Middle East
- [Tenengroup | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/tenengroup-381): Tenengroup MYKA jewelry: Father's Day campaign lowering CPA
- [Dear Me Beauty | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/dear-me-beauty-256): Dear Me Beauty: Indonesian beauty brand sales via In-Feed Ads
- [Bobby | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bobby-268): Bobby diaper brand: Branded Hashtag Challenge in Vietnam market
- [Lipton Ice Tea Romania | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/lipton-ice-tea-romania-286): Lipton Ice Tea Romania: summer flavors awareness campaign on TikTok
